Financial Analyst — Corporate Finance Team
Meridian Holdings

Meridian Holdings is seeking a Financial Analyst to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting for our corporate finance team. Responsibilities include building financial models, analyzing variances, and preparing presentations for senior leadership.

Qualified candidates should have a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field, along with at least two years of relevant experience. Advanced Excel skills are required, and experience with financial modeling software is a plus.

This is a full-time, on-site position. Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to finance-jobs@meridianholdings.com by the end of next month.

Notice: New Cafeteria Payment System

Starting next month, our cafeteria will transition to a cashless payment system. Employees will be able to pay using their employee ID badge, which can be pre-loaded with funds through the company portal, in addition to standard credit and debit cards.

This change is intended to speed up checkout lines during peak lunch hours. Employees who prefer to continue using cash may do so at a designated cash-only register, though wait times may be longer at that station.

A short guide on how to load funds onto your badge will be emailed to all staff this week.
passage2:
To: cafeteria@company.com
From: r.esposito@company.com
Subject: Question about badge payments

Hello,

I read the notice about the new cashless system and wanted to ask a couple of questions. First, is there a minimum amount I need to load onto my badge, or can I add any amount I choose?

Second, if I accidentally load too much money, is it possible to get a refund for the unused balance?

Thank you,
Rosa Esposito
passage3:
To: r.esposito@company.com
From: cafeteria@company.com
Subject: RE: Question about badge payments

Hi Rosa,

Thanks for reaching out! There is no minimum amount required — you can load as little as $5 or as much as $200 at a time through the company portal.

Regarding refunds, yes, any unused balance can be refunded at the end of each quarter by submitting a request through the same portal. Balances under $10 will simply roll over to the next quarter automatically if no refund is requested.

Let us know if you have any other questions before the system launches!

Best,
Cafeteria Services

PeakTeam Training — Corporate Team-Building Programs

Strengthen your team with PeakTeam's customized workshops, designed to improve communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Programs range from half-day workshops to multi-day retreats, held either at our outdoor facility or on-site at your office.

Our most popular package, the Full-Day Challenge, combines outdoor activities with guided reflection sessions and costs $150 per participant, with discounts available for groups over 30 people.

Contact us at info@peakteam.com to schedule a consultation and receive a customized proposal for your organization.

After 25 years in business, Bell & Ivy Bookshop will close its physical storefront next month, but owner Grace Bell announced the store will continue operating exclusively online. Bell cited rising rent costs and changing shopping habits as the main reasons behind the decision.

Loyal customers have expressed disappointment about losing the neighborhood gathering spot, though many have also praised Bell's efforts to preserve the business in a new form. The online store will feature the same curated selection of independent titles the shop was known for.

A farewell event is planned for the shop's final week, including author readings and a storewide clearance sale.
